private_records.release_rule: Provide the current migration ID and downtime.
Sign off only against M-17 and 45 minutes.
Approve only with the QA sign-off cited.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.

adapter_status: declarative v2 format; not compatible with legacy simulator without adapter
npc_behavior: deterministic rules represented as data; execution engine not included
